Three runs recorded 2026-09-04, concatenated in order and put through normalise(): `git commit -m "add twelve files"` with twelve staged new files (its answer line lands FIRST, fourteen lines above the tail), then `git commit -m "the first commit"` in a fresh repository (the root-commit form), then the same on a detached HEAD. The last two carry a SPACE in the bracket first field, which is what a S+ pattern cannot cross.
